_comment: Each track's data file carries a modelScale: the two smaller circuits are modelled at roughly 1:15, and the game scales both the model and the extracted racing line by the same factor so every road is about 18 m wide and the cars stay life-sized. roadMaterials lists the materials that make up the racing surface; tools/verify_track.mjs asserts the surface under the racing line is one of them. asphalt (optional) names materials to restyle as road surface: the Yoyleland tarmac is untextured and washes out to a pale brown under the sun, which hides both the banking and the cars' shadows.
